headlines.title: Bilt Introduces the Operating System for Neighborhoods, Bilt Neighborhood OS™, Connecting Businesses and Communities to Power Local Commerce
headlines.summary: NEW YORK, November 10, 2026--Bilt today announced the next evolution of its platform, introducing the operating system for neighborhoods – Bilt Neighborhood OS: an AI operating system and commerce network designed to help businesses grow by reaching new customers, building loyalty, and making everyday life more rewarding for the communities around them.

headlines.title: Robots and surge pricing won't save fast food: Robert Irvine
headlines.summary: World-class chef and entrepreneur, Robert Irvine explains to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi why dynamic pricing is a little much, and why McDonald's burger-flipping robot and Chipotle's avocado-peeling machine can't replace the one thing that actually keeps customers coming back.

headlines.title: The business mistake McDonald's and Chipotle keep making: Robert Irvine
headlines.summary: World-class chef and entrepreneur, Robert Irvine explains to Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi how he helped push through the legislative change that's replacing 50-year-old Army mess halls with campus-style dining

headlines.title: Marriott International (MAR) Enters Laos With Luxury Collection Debut In Luang Prabang
headlines.summary: Marriott International (NasdaqGS:MAR) has entered Laos with the opening of La Résidence Phou Vao in Luang Prabang. The property joins Marriott’s Luxury Collection portfolio and is located in a UNESCO World Heritage city in northern Laos. La Résidence Phou Vao expands Marriott’s presence in Southeast Asia into a new national market that targets high-end leisure tourism.

headlines.title: Aimbridge Hospitality Selected to Manage Seattle Marriott Redmond
headlines.summary: PLANO, Texas, November 06, 2026--Aimbridge Hospitality has been selected to manage the Seattle Marriott Redmond. The company will assume management of the hotel in January 2027.

description: Marriott International, Inc. engages in the operation, franchising, and licensing of hotel, residential, timeshare, and other lodging properties in the United States, Canada, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Greater China, the Asia-Pacific, and internationally. The company operates properties under the JW Marriott, The Ritz-Carlton, The Luxury Collection, W Hotels, St. Regis, EDITION, Bvlgari, Marriott Hotels, Sheraton, Westin, Autograph Collection, Renaissance Hotels, Le Méridien, Delta Hotels by Marriott, MGM Collection with Marriott Bonvoy, Tribute Portfolio, Gaylord Hotels, Design Hotels, Marriott Executive Apartments, Apartments by Marriott Bonvoy, Courtyard by Marriott, Fairfield by Marriott, Residence Inn by Marriott, SpringHill Suites by Marriott, Four Points by Sheraton, TownePlace Suites by Marriott, Aloft Hotels, AC Hotels by Marriott, Moxy Hotels, Element Hotels, Protea Hotels by Marriott, citizenM, City Express by Marriott, and Four Points Flex by Sheraton brands. It also operates residences, timeshares, and yachts. The company was formerly known as New Marriott MI, Inc. and changed its name to Marriott International, Inc. in May 1998. Marriott International, Inc. was founded in 1927 and is headquartered in Bethesda, Maryland.
